help.title: Help & Support
help.subtitle: Find answers to common questions or reach us directly.
help.messageSentDesc: We'll get back to you as soon as possible.
help.subject: Subject
help.faq1q: How do I book a service?
help.faq1a: Go to the Services tab, choose the service you need, pick a date and time slot, confirm your address, and complete the booking. You'll receive a confirmation once a worker is assigned.
help.faq2q: Can I reschedule or cancel my booking?
help.faq2a: Yes. Open your booking from the My Bookings tab and use the reschedule or cancel option before the worker starts. Cancellations made at least 2 hours before the appointment are free of charge.
help.faq3q: How do I pay for a service?
help.faq3a: We accept UPI payments only. After the worker marks the job as complete, you'll receive a payment QR code. Scan it with any UPI app to complete the payment.
help.faq4q: What if the worker doesn't show up?
help.faq4a: If your worker is more than 15 minutes late without notice, please contact our support number immediately. We'll arrange a replacement or issue a full refund.
help.faq5a: All workers go through ID verification, background checks, and a training assessment before they are allowed to take bookings on the platform.
help.faq6q: How do I raise a complaint about a completed service?
help.faq6a: Call our support number within 24 hours of service completion. Provide your booking ID and describe the issue. Our team will review and respond within one business day.
help.faq7a: Yes. We only share your name and general address area with the assigned worker. Your phone number is never disclosed. All data is stored securely and never sold to third parties.
